CALL US : (780) 439-0050 Book an AppointmentEmail US 2 LOCATIONS TO SERVE YOU ABOUT SERVICES OUR PRICES TAX-TIPS REVIEWS CHECKLIST RESOURCE CENTER CONTACT COMPARE and SAVE on Book-Keeping and year end accounting for small and medium size business Book an Appointment OUR SERVICES BUSINESS SET-UP We will assist you with all aspects of starting a new business including selection of an appropriate legal structure, registration with taxation authorities, budgeting and cash flow analysis and obtaining financing. BOOK KEEPING Meaningful, well-organized financial records ensure that your business operations will run more efficiently on a daily basis and are the foundation of a successful business. Our qualified staff can assist you with the day-to-day tasks associated with bookkeeping. PAYROLL We will provide guidance and assist with the preparation of regular payroll transactions. We also prepare monthly payroll remittance returns and annual T4 and other government filings. We can also assist you in implementing the controls necessary to ensure a reliable, efficient, and effective payroll system. GST RETURN Many of our clients are responsible for collecting and submitting sales taxes in many different jurisdictions. Our experienced staff can develop tax-minimization strategies to optimize your after-tax position. CORPORATE TAX RETURN We will prepare all required schedules and documentation for Canadian federal and provincial corporate tax filings in compliance with the appropriate legislation. SELF EMPLOYED TAX RETURN If you're self-employed and your business is not incorporated, you must file an individual tax return each year. You report your income as business or professional income. And you can deduct (or "write off") business expenses. We will prepare all required documents and help you understanding the return. PERSONAL TAX RETURN Our tax professionals offer convenient, accurate, and affordable preparation of all types of tax returns. We will prepare your T1 Personal Income Tax Return and applicable schedules. CONSULTATION We offer both personal and business consultation. Whether you need advice on acquiring a business or need help with appealing personal tax return, our trained and professional staff will help and guide you in right direction.
